Bill.BriefDescription: Providing that the manufacturing innovation and modernization extension service program is not to sunset.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing that the manufacturing innovation andmodernization extension service program is not to sunset; amending RCW43.338.040; and repealing RCW 43.131.409 and 43.131.410.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.338.040 and 2008 c 315 s 6 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any qualified manufacturing extension partnership affiliatereceiving funding under the program shall collect and submit to thedepartment annually data on the number of clients served, the scope ofservices provided, and outcomes achieved during the previous calendaryear. By December 1 of the year following any calendar year in whichfunding was received under the program, the department must evaluatethe data submitted and use it in a ((biennial)) report on the programsubmitted to the appropriate committees of the legislature.

The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 43.131.409 (Manufacturing innovation and modernizationextension service programTermination) and 2008 c 315 s 7; and p. 1 EHB 1674 RCW 43.131.410 (Manufacturing innovation and modernizationextension service programRepeal) and 2008 c 315 s 8.
